name: Vikunja
short_description: Self-hosted open-source to-do and project manager.
description: Vikunja is an open-source, self-hosted task management platform. Organize your work with lists, kanban boards, Gantt charts, and a calendar view. It offers teams and namespaces for collaboration, labels, priorities, due dates, and a REST API.
usecases: Manage personal tasks and to-do lists with due dates and priorities.
Run team projects with kanban boards and task assignments.
Plan and track work using Gantt charts and calendar views.
